The two deposits do not need to be consecutive, but must total a minimum of $800 across two months during the 3 month qualification period. If direct deposit is not made within the qualification period, $150 bonus is forfeited. Offer cannot be combined with any other offer and is limited to one $150 bonus per new personal checking account per member. Offer does not apply to business or multiple checking accounts. Offer subject to change or cancelation at any time. Bonus may constitute taxable income for you. CRCU may issue an IRS Form 1099 to you. For new CRCU members only.

steps: Join CRCU as a new member and open a new personal Reward Checking account.
Receive at least two direct deposits of $400 or more in two separate months within the 3-month qualification period (minimum $800 total; deposits need not be consecutive).
Keep the account open and in good standing through the 3-month period.
Collect the $150 bonus after the qualification period.
